transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Well... work, mostly. I drive a truck down at the warehouse. But... the routing system there... it's not just a regular computer anymore. 

I... I know it's been marking my moves. Sending these messages through the scanners. Just... trying to push me out. Because I'm one of the old hands. I don't really know what else to say about it.
Have you been feeling unusually depressed, hopeless, or perhaps abnormally energetic and wired during the time you've noticed these things happening at work?

...I guess you could say I've been low. Real low. 

I wasn't... I mean, I was barely eating for a while. Stopped going to choir. Just felt like I'd failed everybody, to be honest. And... yeah, when I was at my absolute lowest like that, that's when the scanner messages were coming through. The voices on the dispatch, too... they were happening right along with it. 

I definitely wasn't energetic or wired. Just... down.
Have there been any periods in your life, even for a few weeks, where you experienced these messages and voices but were not feeling depressed or low?

...Yeah. I suppose there was a stretch like that. 

My mood had... eased up some. I was eating again, talking a little more. But... for a few weeks there, I still heard the dispatch calling my number. I still knew the routing system was tracking me. So... yeah. It was still happening, even when I wasn't so low.
How long have you been dealing with these experiences regarding the scanner and the dispatch voices—has it been going on for more than six months?

...Yeah. It's been longer than six months. 

I guess... if I think about it, it's been about a year and eight months. Give or take. That's how long the voices and the... the scanner stuff has been going on.

Aside from the voices and the scanner issues, have you felt like you've lost your drive to do things, or have you noticed that your emotions have become more flat or muted compared to how you used to be?

...I suppose so. 

My wife... she tells me my face has gone flat. Says I barely answer her anymore. And... well, most days, I just end up sitting at the kitchen table. Just staring at my coffee. I don't really start anything that needs doing around the house. Just... sit there. So, yeah. I guess I have lost my drive.

Looking back over the entire year and eight months that you've been dealing with these voices and thoughts, would you say you were feeling depressed or low for most of that time, or were the periods where your mood was fine longer than the periods where you felt down?

...Mostly depressed, I guess. 

Even when the... the warehouse stuff wasn't as loud, I just... I was still down. Empty. I haven't been able to get back into fishing... or my woodworking. Don't really care about family meals either. Just... yeah. Most of the time, it's been like that.

Looking at that entire year and eight months, would you say you were feeling depressed or low for the vast majority of that time, or were there long stretches where your mood was actually quite normal?

...I think I just said that. 

It's been... mostly the whole time. Even if the warehouse stuff wasn't bothering me as much for a few days, I was still... just empty. Didn't want to fish. Didn't want to go out to the shop. Didn't care about dinner with the family. Just... most of the time. Yeah.

Thinking back to that period of a few weeks where your mood felt better, was that the only time you experienced the voices and scanner messages while not feeling depressed, or has there been any other time during this last year and eight months where you felt like your mood was normal but the voices and scanner issues were still happening?

...I guess there was one other time. 

My mood had... lifted a bit. I was eating better. Talking a little more to my wife. But... the dispatch was still calling my number. For a few weeks, I still heard them. And... I still knew the routing system was tracking me. Even though I wasn't feeling as low. So... yeah.
During any of the time you have been dealing with these experiences, has there ever been a period where you felt unusually elated, irritable, or so energized that you didn't need to sleep?
No. I haven't... I haven't felt like that. Just the opposite, mostly. Never... elated, or whatever you said.

When you are talking to your wife or to me, do you ever find that your thoughts get jumbled, or that you have trouble keeping your sentences on track so that people have a hard time following what you are saying?

...No. I don't think so. 

I mean, I don't talk much these days anyway. But... when I do, people understand me fine, I guess. My wife hasn't said anything about my sentences getting off track. Just... no.
